title: Recipe
description: One recipe. Ingredients are the leaves of a tree. Each step uses ingredients and earlier steps, and makes one new thing.

description.description: One or two sentences for the recipe card.

yield.description: What the recipe makes, such as "16 brownies" or "4 servings". A number at the start scales.

images.description: Pictures for the Images view. The first one is also the picture on the recipe card.

src.description: A file name in this recipe's folder, or a full URL.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for screen readers.

choices.description: Parts of the recipe that the cook can change, such as the flour or the mix-in. The page shows a row of buttons for each choice. An ingredient, step, or nutrition entry with "when" is only for some options.

id.description: Lowercase letters, numbers, and "-", such as "mix-in". In a step, {mix-in} shows the label of the selected option.

label.description: The name of the choice on the page, such as "Mix-in".

options.description: Two or more options. The first one is the default.

id.description: Lowercase letters, numbers, and "-", such as "dates".

label.description: The text on the button, and the text for {choice-id} in steps. Write it as it reads in a sentence, such as "chocolate chips".

note.description: Shown when the cook selects this option, such as "Chickpea flour is stickier, so this version has milk."

id.description: A short name that steps use to refer to this ingredient.

amount.description: The amount as you write it, such as "1-1/2 cups" or "2 large". A number at the start scales.

metric.description: The same amount in metric units, such as "190 g".

note.description: Shown after the name, such as "softened".

group.description: A heading in the Text view, such as "Frosting". Put ingredients of one group next to each other.

recipe.description: The folder name of another recipe that makes this ingredient.

when.description: The options that this ingredient is for, as choice id and option id, such as { "flour": "chickpea" }. Leave it out for an ingredient that all options use.

steps.description: In the order that you do them. A step can only use ingredients and earlier steps, and each one only once.

id.description: Give an id to each step that a later step uses.

action.description: The short text in the table, such as "melt" or "bake 350°F 30 min".

inputs.description: Ids of ingredients and earlier steps. Leave this out for a prep step, such as "Preheat oven".

text.description: The full instruction for the Text and Cook views. If you leave it out, they show the action.

when.description: The options that this step is for, as choice id and option id, such as { "flour": "chickpea" }. Leave it out for a step that all options use. A step whose inputs are all for other options is left out too.

nutrition.description: Estimated nutrition, such as one entry per 100 g and one per cookie. The values do not scale. In a recipe with choices, use "when" so that each combination of options has its values.

per.description: The portion, such as "100 g" or "1 cookie".

carbs.description: Carbohydrate, in grams. This includes the sugar and the fiber.

when.description: The options that these values are for, as choice id and option id, such as { "flour": "chickpea", "mix-in": "dates" }. Leave out a choice that does not change the values.
